goal: Produce direct six-domain, OOXML, installed Office, facticity, acceptance, and SpecNav evidence for the complete DocForge migration.
test_paths: pnpm --dir frontend typecheck && pnpm --dir frontend lint && pnpm --dir frontend test && pnpm --dir frontend build
pnpm --dir frontend exec playwright test --config e2e/real-http.playwright.config.ts
cargo fmt --check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo check --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
non_goals: Do not implement new product behavior solely to make verification pass without a repair task.
Do not publish or deploy externally without separate authorization.
Do not start arbitrary Markdown importing or the npm Agent Skill.
expected_evidence: System-executed Python, frontend, Rust, E2E, and OpenSpec receipts
Installed macOS and Microsoft Word sensory evidence
Task report, independent spec review, and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A prior green run is not current evidence.
File existence is not sufficient OOXML verification.
Browser or mock transport evidence is not installed desktop evidence.
Every old term found by scan is not necessarily an active contract defect.
stop_condition: Stop on any unadjudicated executed failure, missing acceptance evidence, unresolved active obsolete identifier, unavailable required Office check, or scope expansion into the importer skill.
